# Run ledger — S1.14 (Telemetry, tracing & cost/latency instrumentation, R-2.9.1 C0/Stage 1)

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/018_S1.14__telemetry.md` (cites
  `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5h.1 R-2.9.1 only — the C0/Stage-1 slice per the §5h.1 §9
  stage map: scope kinds M1–M12 wired to the ledger classes incl.
  `model.call.attempt.*`, units/clock conventions (`measured_at`, monotonic
  durations, `clock_tolerance_ms`, `clock_skew_flag`), `TokenVector` normalization
  with `normalizer_ref`, `SinkPolicy` + the L0–L3 content classes,
  `measurement.export.delivered`, propagation at the subprocess seam, and the
  process-metric registry populated with the catalogue's names and requirements
  (ADR-0042/0043/0044 (e)).
  Owning ADRs: ADR-0042 (D1/D2 — views are projections, never a second store; D3 —
  export is lowering, propagation across seams; D5 — scope closure audited; D6 —
  measurement rows), ADR-0043 (D1 closed measurement-point list; D2–D5 clocks,
  `Money`, `TokenVector` conventions; D6 `ResourceVector` rollup; D7 loss-listed
  conversions), ADR-0044 (D1/D2 L0–L3 instrumentation classes; D3 `SinkPolicy`;
  D5 catalogue rows; D6 `ArtifactExposure`).
- **Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.13` @ `3d5a925`
- **Branch:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.14`
- **Config:** implement-spec full rigor; autonomous=true; committed build-memory mode.
- **Live stage:** offline-only — every view is a pure fold over the durable prefix
  (ADR-0042 D2); exporters are subscribers; propagation renders env-var pairs for
  the subprocess seam (the live injection lands with the executor, S1.16/S2.x).
  Verification is the `cargo` suites.

## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first (rule 1). Dispositions this run:
- **DF-S1.5-2** — "the metric registry check resolves `requires_observability`
  against `hh_ledger::classes::ClassSpec::min_observability` for every class a
  metric reads". §5h.1 §9's Stage-1 row lands "the registry populated with the
  catalogue's names and requirements" — the `ProcessMetric` catalogue +
  `registry_check` land here ⇒ candidate for closure, verified below.
- All other `OPEN` rows are out of this ticket's scope (ledger Stage-2 ops,
  cross-implementation corpora, security Stage-2/3/4 halves).

## Progress
- Created `crates/hh-telemetry` (workspace member; deps
  `hh-wire`/`hh-identity`/`hh-provenance`/`hh-ontology`/`hh-ledger`/`hh-budget`
  only — no `Text` leaf authored, no model call on any path).
- `scope.rs` — the closed `ScopeKind` sum (16 kinds: run, turn, model_call,
  model_attempt, context_assembly, compaction, tool_call, tool_attempt, effect,
  permission, validation, subagent, environment_op, memory_op, wakeup,
  component_call) + the verbatim `MEASUREMENT_POINTS` table (M1–M19 +
  M-ENV-1…3) with per-row open/close classes, duration source, measured fields,
  producer and §9 stage stamp. Points whose emitter classes have not landed are
  declared with their stage (`pending`), never absent (CC8).
- `codec.rs`/`errors.rs` — strict canonical JSON helpers (`BadMember`,
  `BadValue`, float rejection via `hh-wire`) and the typed `TelemetryError` sum.
- `clocks.rs` — `MeasuredAt` (adapter / external_gateway / interceptor /
  executor / runtime / participant), `DEFAULT_CLOCK_TOLERANCE_MS = 5`,
  `ts_ms`/`ts_span_ms` canonical-timestamp arithmetic (malformed ⇒ `None`,
  never guessed), `skewed` — the AC-R-2.9.1-13 predicate.
- `tokens.rs` — `TokenVector` strict codec + invariants (nonnegative;
  `input_total = input_uncached + cache_read + cache_write`;
  `output_reasoning ≤ output_total`; optional `output_text ⊆ output_total`;
  `convention = "hh-inclusive/1"`; mandatory `normalizer_ref`) and
  `normalize_usage` converging the four provider shapes (inclusive-cached,
  exclusive-cached, details-nested, flat prompt/completion);
  `cache_hit_rate_ppm` returns `None` on 0/0 — never a fabricated zero.
- `sinks.rs` — the closed L0–L3 `ContentClass` sum and `SinkPolicy`
  (`sink_id`, `content_classes`, `redaction`, `sampling`, `rate_limit?`,
  `max_field_bytes`, `requires_consent`) with construction-time invariants:
  `content` ⇒ consent (`MissingConsent`), `content` ∩ `diagnostic` = ∅,
  coherent sampling shapes, metric-view sinks cannot sample below `all`
  (`ForbiddenSampling`); `version_id` is `idp/1` over canonical bytes.
- `propagation.rs` — the subprocess seam: `outbound_context` renders W3C
  `traceparent`/`tracestate` with the `hh` member + baggage; ids derive via
  `idp/1` domain-separated hashing (`telemetry.trace_id` over `root_run_id`,
  `telemetry.span_id` over `event_id` — OQ-115's provisional derivation);
  `subprocess_env` renders `HH_TRACEPARENT`/`HH_TRACESTATE`/`HH_BAGGAGE`;
  `inbound_context` resolves `hh` members to `EventRef` links and refuses
  malformed context (`InvalidInboundContext` — never parented);
  `PropagationUnsupported(target)` renders a loss entry.
- `events.rs` — payload builders/strict decoders: `Timing{request_sent_ms,
  first_byte_ms?, first_token_ms?, last_byte_ms}` + `measured_at`,
  `metric_emitted_payload`, `export_delivered_payload`.
- `catalogue.rs` — the §8 process-metric catalogue as `ProcessMetric` rows
  (`tokens_total`, `cost_money`, `cache_hit_rate`, `latency_e2e_ms`,
  `ttft_ms`/`ttfm_ms`, `turn_phase_profile`, `tool_error_rate`,
  `approval_wait_ms`, `permission_denials`, …); `registry_check` resolves
  every row's `computed_from` classes against `CLASS_TABLE`'s
  `min_observability` — **closes DF-S1.5-2**; pending classes are declared,
  not violations.
- `views.rs` — the three pure folds, stamped by `View::stamped` (deterministic
  `view_hash`, watermark): `trace_view` (one `Span` per scope-opening event —
  `model_attempt` coordinated as `<model_call_id>/a<attempt_no>` since the
  ledger has no attempt scope field; `SpanStatus{ok, error{class}, open,
  cancelled, rolled_back}`; payload-measured durations preferred; `ts` used
  only for `clock_skew_flag`; non-tree causality via `causes[]`; `open_scopes`
  for missing terminals), `cost_view` (`by_scope`/`by_attribution`/`totals`
  over `hh-budget` `SpendRow`/`Money`/`ResourceVector`; `provenance_mix` map +
  `min` confidence — never averaged; `MixedCurrency` refuses), `metric_view`
  (`value | n/a{reason}` with `computed_from` EventRefs; insufficient
  observability ⇒ typed `n/a`, never 0), `sink_deliveries`.
- `export.rs` — the lowering: `export_view`/`export_events` apply
  `content_classes` (non-`content` sinks get `{ref, len, digest}` projections
  only), `max_field_bytes` truncation (per-field loss entries), deterministic
  `ratio`/`parent_based` sampling (dropped events recorded), and `deliver` —
  the only exporter append, `measurement.export.delivered` through
  `Store::append`.
- `hh-ledger` additive edits — class rows `measurement.export.delivered`
  (audit-grade, provenance-mandatory) and `measurement.metric.emitted`
  (provenance-mandatory); `measurement.cost.attributed` row already landed at
  S1.6 — reused.
- `hh-identity` additive edit — `RecordKind::SinkPolicy` (`sink_policy`,
  version-only).
- 27 unit tests + 10 acceptance tests, all green; workspace suite green.

## Gap analysis vs §5h.1
- **§2.1 views** — `trace_view`/`cost_view`/`metric_view` landed as pure
  `View::stamped` folds. `turn_phase_profile` and `audit_view` are §9 Stage-2
  (the former needs gateway turn-phase timings; the latter is S1.15's
  §05g.6 attestation) — `sink_deliveries` landed as `audit_view`'s input.
  Deferred: DF-S1.14-1.
- **§2.2 emission** — payload builders for `Timing`, `measurement.
  metric.emitted`, `measurement.export.delivered` landed; the producer call
  sites (gateway emitters etc.) belong to the owning subsystems.
  `measurement.metric.emitted`'s producers are oracles/judges (Stage 3).
- **§2.3 propagation** — subprocess env seam landed with OQ-115's provisional
  derivation; MCP/ACP `_meta` + request-header carriers are Stage-2 lowering
  slots. Deferred: DF-S1.14-1.
- **§2.4 export** — lowering with typed `TelemetryLossReport`
  (`dropped_fields`/`truncated_fields`/`unit_conversions`/`unmappable_scopes`),
  consent gate, deterministic sampling, `deliver` append. The live
  subscriber/egress path is a handoff seam. Deferred: DF-S1.14-4.
- **§2.5 points** — the full closed table declared (M1–M19 + M-ENV-1…3);
  M1–M12 wired to existing classes; M5/M6/M13/M14/M15 emitters Stage-2;
  M12 rollup + M18 hosted Stage-4. Deferred: DF-S1.14-1/-3.
- **§2.6 units/clocks** — `MeasuredAt`, monotonic payload durations,
  `clock_tolerance_ms`, `clock_skew_flag`, `Money{micro_units}` (reused
  `hh-budget`), `TokenVector` + `hh-inclusive/1` all landed and tested.
- **§3 records** — `Span`, `CostProvenance`/`confidence` (reused),
  `ResourceVector` (reused), L0–L3, `SinkPolicy`, `TelemetryLossReport`,
  `ArtifactExposure` (declared; its §05c/§05f classes pending),
  `MetricDeclaration` catalogue rows, the two new ledger classes — all landed.
- **§6 provenance** — views confer no authority; `export.delivered` is
  audit-grade + provenance-mandatory; sinks-as-`net_egress` mediation is the
  Stage-2 live seam (DF-S1.14-4).
- **§7 ACs** — Stage-1 criteria {8, 11, 13} executable and green;
  Stage-3/4 criteria tracked under DF-S1.14-2/-3.

## CC1–CC10 analysis
- **CC1** — one canonicalizer (`hh-wire`), one idp/1 hashing path
  (`hh-identity`), one money/resource taxonomy (`hh-budget` types reused — no
  telemetry-local `Money`). Views stamp via the ledger's `View::stamped`.
- **CC2** — views confer no authority; `deliver` appends through
  `Store::append` (the writer lease's rules apply); exporters hold no handle.
- **CC3** — nothing silently lost: `TelemetryLossReport` is mandatory on every
  `Delivery`; `n/a{reason}` replaces zeros; dropped sampled events are
  recorded; `PropagationUnsupported` is an explicit loss entry.
- **CC4** — all records canonical JSON; `SinkPolicy.version_id` is `idp/1`;
  propagation ids derive from canonical identity hashing.
- **CC5** — contract-only reach: telemetry reads `EventEnvelope`/`Scope`/
  `View`/`SpendRow` public types; no internals poked.
- **CC6** — the L0–L3 classes are the spec's closed sum; sampling removes
  export copies only (removability preserved).
- **CC7** — the single `MEASUREMENT_POINTS` table is the machine-checked form
  of §2.5; a spec change is a code change here.
- **CC8** — additive-only: new class rows appended to `CLASS_TABLE`, new
  `RecordKind` variant, new crate; pending measurement points declared with
  stage stamps so later stages land emitters, not renames.
- **CC9** — `metric_view` renders `n/a` under insufficient observability —
  no scored number from a mechanism that cannot see it.
- **CC10** — telemetry owns measurement/sink/projection code; ledger owns
  events/views plumbing; budget owns money taxonomy; identity owns hashing —
  no boundary crossed.

## Deviations
- `model_attempt` spans use the synthetic coordinate `<model_call_id>/a<n>`
  (the ledger `Scope` record has no attempt field; the id exists only in the
  view) — ADR-0245 §2.
- `measurement.metric.emitted` registered `Led`-durable + provenance-mandatory
  but not audit-grade (producers are scorer-boundary oracles, not the kernel)
  — ADR-0245 §5.
- Propagation renders `HH_*` env vars for the subprocess seam only; MCP/ACP/
  header carriers are Stage-2 per §9 — ADR-0245 §3.
